response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly skilled, experienced software engineer (~15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure) with entrepreneurial spirit and teaching experience, but the resume shows little depth in AI/ML and no evidence of director-level strategic scope, customer advisory work, or building recognized AI products/platforms — all core requirements for this Principal Engineer AI Strategy role.
strengths: Extensive (15+ year) and versatile engineering background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Entrepreneurial track record as founder of GISCollective and history of public speaking/workshops showing thought-leadership potential
Demonstrated adaptability across many languages, stacks, and problem domains (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++, Java, cloud/K8s)
concerns: Minimal, very recent AI exposure (MCP tooling since April 2025) — no demonstrated AI products, platforms, or recognized AI expertise
No evidence of Director-level or Principal-level strategic responsibilities such as advising executives, strategic partners, or shaping company-wide cloud/AI strategy
No Master's/PhD in AI and no track record of enterprise-scale cloud strategy or influence at a principal/staff+ level in large organizations

key_factors.factor: No evidence of Director-level strategic/advisory experience
Long, broad engineering experience meeting years-of-experience bar
